lore.realms_of_chaos.zeus.1: Olympus was not always a tower. It was a mountain, and the gods stacked it floor on floor when Chaos came for the sky.
lore.realms_of_chaos.zeus.2: The Storm Hoplites do not remember being men. They remember an oath, and nothing before it.
lore.realms_of_chaos.zeus.3: Hebe poured the last cup of ambrosia the night the gates were broken. Nobody has grown older here since.
lore.realms_of_chaos.zeus.4: Athena drew the passages herself. She is said to have laughed only once while she did it.
lore.realms_of_chaos.zeus.5: A Keeper is not set to guard a seal. A Keeper is what is left of whoever broke the one before it.
lore.realms_of_chaos.zeus.6: The aegis was a shield once, and one god's. Now every god raises one, and none of them recalls being taught.
lore.realms_of_chaos.zeus.7: Hermes still runs messages between floors. There has been nobody to read them for a very long time.
lore.realms_of_chaos.zeus.8: When the floor shifts under you, that is Olympus turning in its sleep.
lore.realms_of_chaos.poseidon.1: The Abyss was the bed of the first sea. Poseidon drowned it a second time to keep Chaos out.
lore.realms_of_chaos.poseidon.2: Sirens sing the same song they sang to sailors. Down here it is a lullaby for something much larger.
lore.realms_of_chaos.poseidon.3: Every pearl in these halls was a promise made to the sea. The sea keeps promises. It keeps everything.
lore.realms_of_chaos.poseidon.4: The Telchines forged the trident, and were cast down for boasting of it. They forge still, and say nothing.
lore.realms_of_chaos.poseidon.5: Tide Priests mend what is broken because the tide does: it takes, and then it brings back.
lore.realms_of_chaos.poseidon.6: No light reaches the Trench. What glows there has learnt to do without.
lore.realms_of_chaos.poseidon.7: Amphitrite counts the waves. If she ever finishes, they say, the sea will stop.
lore.realms_of_chaos.poseidon.8: The water in the rune chambers is older than the towers. It remembers being rain.
lore.realms_of_chaos.hades.1: Nobody is kept in the Underworld. They simply cannot think of anywhere else to go.
lore.realms_of_chaos.hades.2: Charon was paid once for every soul. He has spent none of it, and will not say what he is saving for.
lore.realms_of_chaos.hades.3: The Lethe runs through the lowest passages. Those who drink of it fight on without knowing why.
lore.realms_of_chaos.hades.4: Shades do not hate the living. They are trying to remember what warmth was.
lore.realms_of_chaos.hades.5: Persephone planted the gardens in these halls. They flower in the dark, out of spite.
lore.realms_of_chaos.hades.6: Thanatos has never hurried, and has never been late.
lore.realms_of_chaos.hades.7: The Furies were sent after oath-breakers. Since the gates fell, everyone here is one.
lore.realms_of_chaos.hades.8: A soul warden carries its charges' wounds because it could not carry them in life.

handbook.realms_of_chaos.start.title: Getting started
handbook.realms_of_chaos.start.line1: Welcome to Realms of Chaos, and thank you for using our mod.
handbook.realms_of_chaos.start.line2: You have been given three things: the Codex of Chaos (this menu), the Compass of Chaos, and a letter from the Oracle. Read the letter - it is the start of the story.
handbook.realms_of_chaos.start.line3: The realms of the gods are closed until you find a way in. Right-click the Compass of Chaos: it scans for the nearest Ruined Gate. You also carry a Field Tower Bag with two Relay Tower Cores and a Waygate Obelisk in it.
handbook.realms_of_chaos.start.line4: This handbook is always here: open the Codex and choose Handbook.
handbook.realms_of_chaos.way_in.title: Finding the way in
handbook.realms_of_chaos.way_in.line1: A Ruined Gate is a broken stone plaza with a dead arch and a campfire still smoking. You will see the smoke first.
handbook.realms_of_chaos.way_in.line2: Its chest holds three seekers. Each is a compass for one keystone: right-click it and it tells you how far and which way its citadel is. The citadels lie far apart - a long journey each.
handbook.realms_of_chaos.way_in.line3: Each keystone is kept in a citadel - white and gold for the Sky, prismarine behind a moat for the Tides, black stone ringed with soul fire for the Shades. Half-kin hold the walls and towers; on the roof of the keep, beside the keystone, waits a fallen Titan. Climb the keep's stairs to reach it. Go armed.
handbook.realms_of_chaos.way_in.line4: Bring the three keystones back and right-click the pedestal with each. The arch fills. Step through, and the gate knows you. Nothing carries you to the hub in an instant: you walk through a gate, or you channel at a Waygate Obelisk.
handbook.realms_of_chaos.compass.title: The compass scans
handbook.realms_of_chaos.compass.line1: The Compass of Chaos does not carry you anywhere. Right-click and it scans for a minute to a minute and a half. Keep it in hand and read the line above your hotbar: an arrow (up is straight ahead), a distance, the signal, the time left.
handbook.realms_of_chaos.compass.line2: Every two or three seconds the needle rolls. Most rolls are rough - off by more the poorer the signal. A Clean Lock (green, with a trail of light) is exact. A Static Surge (red) is nonsense. The longer a scan runs, the truer it gets, and its best reading is written to chat at the end.
handbook.realms_of_chaos.compass.line3: Sneak and right-click turns the compass to what it looks for: the way to the hub, the keystone shrines, or relays and waygates.
handbook.realms_of_chaos.compass.line4: Signal: Relay Towers within 96 blocks steady it (up to three). A higher hub tier steadies it. Rain, thunder and being deep underground spoil it, and so does another player's Signal Jammer.
handbook.realms_of_chaos.network.title: Relays, jammers, waygates
handbook.realms_of_chaos.network.line1: Your Field Tower Bag starts with two Relay Tower Cores and a Waygate Obelisk. Right-click opens the bag; sneak and right-click a block sets down the first of them without opening it. All three can be crafted, broken and carried.
handbook.realms_of_chaos.network.line2: A Relay Tower Core steadies every compass within 96 blocks. A Signal Jammer spoils the scans of everyone within 64 blocks except its owner and their party.
handbook.realms_of_chaos.network.line3: A Waygate Obelisk is a place to travel from and to. Right-click it and choose: the Hub of Realms (once a Ruined Gate knows you) or any other obelisk you have touched. Then stand still for five seconds - move or be hit and it lets go. Each journey costs one ender pearl.
handbook.realms_of_chaos.traps.title: Rune chambers
handbook.realms_of_chaos.traps.line1: Some rooms of a passage are rune chambers: a rune stone on a pillar in each corner and a marked square in the middle. Step onto the square and the trap springs - the doorways close and water rises a layer at a time.
handbook.realms_of_chaos.traps.line2: The runes light up in an order, again and again. Right-click them in that order and the room drains, opens, and gives each of you forge material (once). A wrong rune starts the order again and the water leaps up a layer.
handbook.realms_of_chaos.traps.line3: It is a trap, not a grave: once full it hurts whoever is inside for a quarter of a minute, then lets go by itself, with no reward. It never springs for someone who has already solved it.
handbook.realms_of_chaos.rooms.title: Levels, puzzles and traps
handbook.realms_of_chaos.rooms.line1: A passage has anywhere from one to ten levels - more the higher in a tower - and each is named: 7-B2 is passage 7, wing B, level 2. Wings are three levels long and each is built of different stone.
handbook.realms_of_chaos.rooms.line2: You are handed a Passage Chart: a map that starts blank and inks in each room as you walk into it. The next level is built while you explore the one you are on.
handbook.realms_of_chaos.rooms.line3: Puzzle rooms keep a cache locked. A vault: press the glyph tiles until all nine are lit (each turns its neighbours too). A chime room: ring all four crystals before the first falls silent. A beam room: set the mirrors so the light reaches the receiver - some are decoys, and turns are counted. A trembling floor: only one path of plates holds - it glimmers every few seconds, and has to be walked from its first plate.
handbook.realms_of_chaos.rooms.line4: A rune chamber shuts you in: press its runes in order to get out. A flood shows the order over and over; a furnace shows it once; the gloom wants it backwards. Trap halls are only to be got through. A crusher hall marks a row, and a breath later brings the ceiling down on it. A dart hall has marked tiles that loose arrows from the walls. Most trap halls do not show what they are: look for stained tiles and old bones, watch for a wisp over a tile before it goes off, and wait just inside the doorway, where it is always safe.
handbook.realms_of_chaos.rooms.line5: Urns can be smashed for a little loot - or for the sentinel hiding inside. Lore tablets tell a line of the tower's story.
handbook.realms_of_chaos.mastery.title: Mastery
handbook.realms_of_chaos.mastery.line1: You earn a point for every god you wake and every passage you walk for the first time. Spend them in the Codex under Mastery, or with /roc skills.
handbook.realms_of_chaos.mastery.line2: Combat: Might, Swiftness, Focus (relic moves return sooner), Reach. Survival: Vigor, Guard, Steadiness, Second Wind. Exploration: Cartographer, Signal, Scavenger, Pathfinder.
handbook.realms_of_chaos.mastery.line3: Every skill has three ranks. Nothing is ever lost: the tree can be taken apart and the points spent again.
handbook.realms_of_chaos.hub_tiers.title: The hub grows
handbook.realms_of_chaos.hub_tiers.line1: The Heart of the Hub stands south of the middle of the plaza. Right-click it for Hub Command: the hub's tier, what each tier does, and what the next one asks for. Everyone on the world shares one hub and anyone can add to the pile.
handbook.realms_of_chaos.hub_tiers.line2: Tier II: steadier compasses, a hub that mends you, and the Bounty Board. Tier III: six-row Field Bags, and the hub lifts every harm. Tier IV: three-second waygates, and the needle rolls every two seconds. Tier V: free waygates.
handbook.realms_of_chaos.hub_tiers.line3: The Bounty Board posts three bounties a day, the same for everyone. Each player earns them for themselves and claims forge materials at the board.
handbook.realms_of_chaos.phases.title: A trial's three phases
handbook.realms_of_chaos.phases.line1: A god fights as itself down to 65% of its health. No single blow carries it past that mark, or the next.
handbook.realms_of_chaos.phases.line2: At 65% it raises its aegis: nothing can hurt it while its shield pylons stand. Find them round the floor and right-click each until it breaks. Left alone, an aegis fades after 75 seconds.
handbook.realms_of_chaos.phases.line3: At 30% comes its wrath: a last stand, the floor lost ring by ring from the wall inward, and strikes from above. Each strike is marked by a ring on the floor for a second and a half first.
handbook.realms_of_chaos.phases.line4: A god watches how it is fought. Shoot it and it turns shots aside and closes in; stay hand to hand and its guard lashes back. It also measures your best weapon, its enchantments and your armour when the trial begins, and rises to match. The world's difficulty sets its health and pace.
handbook.realms_of_chaos.hub.title: The Hub of Realms
handbook.realms_of_chaos.hub.line1: Three gates lead to three towers: Zeus to the north, Poseidon to the east, Hades to the west. The south gate takes you home.
handbook.realms_of_chaos.hub.line2: The Oracle's Flame burns just north of where you arrive. Right-click it for the story so far and for what to do next.
handbook.realms_of_chaos.hub.line3: Two Forges of Chaos stand south of the middle. The figures beside the gates are echoes of the gods. They only watch.
handbook.realms_of_chaos.hub.line4: Nothing in the realms can be broken or built on. You get your tools back the moment you leave.
handbook.realms_of_chaos.trials.title: Towers and trials
handbook.realms_of_chaos.trials.line1: Each tower has fifteen floors and one god to a floor. Floor 1 is the gentlest; the king waits on floor 15.
handbook.realms_of_chaos.trials.line2: Right-click the Trial Altar on a floor to see who waits there, what their move is and what they drop, and to begin the trial.
handbook.realms_of_chaos.trials.line3: Beat the god and the Gate of Ascent opens at the far side of the floor. It leads into the passage to the next floor.
handbook.realms_of_chaos.trials.line4: A god you have beaten can be called back from its altar for a rematch. Rematches drop forge materials.
handbook.realms_of_chaos.fights.title: Reading a fight
handbook.realms_of_chaos.fights.line1: Tap sneak, or raise a shield, just as a blow would land and it is parried: no harm done, the attacker reels, and your next blow within three seconds is a riposte, half as hard again. A parried bolt goes back to whoever loosed it. Sentinels draw back before a heavy blow - that is the one to parry.
handbook.realms_of_chaos.fights.line2: Blows landed without being hit build momentum, up to five, and each point adds a little to every blow. A blow on a reeling enemy counts half as much again, and one struck while falling shakes everything round it.
handbook.realms_of_chaos.fights.line3: Every god has a signature move with a name, and raises its arms before it: that is your warning. Turn on the cast bar in the Codex's settings and each move is named and counted down as it comes.
handbook.realms_of_chaos.fights.line4: The gods remember how you fight. Shoot from afar, hide behind a shield, stop to heal or keep out of reach in trial after trial, and the next god has an answer ready. The Codex shows what they know of you; fight differently and they forget.
handbook.realms_of_chaos.fights.line5: Rings on the ground mean it is about to erupt there. Step out. A hex bursts two seconds after it lands unless you get well away.
handbook.realms_of_chaos.fights.line6: At half health a god is enraged: it glows, moves faster, and the floor starts to throw itself up under your feet. Keep moving when you see dust.
handbook.realms_of_chaos.fights.line7: At a fifth of its health it makes a last stand: for two seconds nothing can hurt it, sentinels answer its call, and then it uses everything it has.
handbook.realms_of_chaos.fights.line8: The floor itself changes shape as the fight goes on. If a god beats you, it comes back a little weaker next time.
handbook.realms_of_chaos.passages.title: Passages
handbook.realms_of_chaos.passages.line1: Between every two floors lies a passage: one to ten levels, each a maze of rooms. No two worlds have the same ones, and no two rooms are quite alike: low or tall, wide, ringed with columns, sunk a step into the floor.
handbook.realms_of_chaos.passages.line2: Some halls never rest. Spikes come up by the colour of the tile, fire walks a flame hall row by row, and a blade sweeps a blade hall from wall to wall. Each shows what it is about to do: watch, then go. A stairwell has a loft, and a cache on it.
handbook.realms_of_chaos.passages.line3: The gate at the end of a level is sealed. Find every seal on that level and break it. The bar at the top counts them.
handbook.realms_of_chaos.passages.line4: A sealed chamber wakes its sentinels when you walk in. When they have fallen, right-click the seal and strike it: click when the hammer is on the yellow mark.
handbook.realms_of_chaos.passages.line5: The Codex opens a map of the level you are on. The Compass of Chaos points to the nearest seal, then to the gate.
handbook.realms_of_chaos.passages.line6: Whoever breaks a seal is offered three boons and takes one; they last until the passage is behind you. A shrine shows the whole of its level on your chart.
handbook.realms_of_chaos.passages.line7: Treasure caches give every player their own share. Shrines heal you. Arenas hold an elite, and a better cache. Each level up is harder than the last.
handbook.realms_of_chaos.sentinels.title: Sentinels
handbook.realms_of_chaos.sentinels.line1: Soldiers close in. Casters keep their distance and shoot. Skirmishers are quick and leap at you. Brutes are slow and send you flying.
handbook.realms_of_chaos.sentinels.line2: Mystics hang back and help the rest: the Storm Augur quickens them, the Tide Priest heals them, the Necromancer raises more. Deal with the mystic first.
handbook.realms_of_chaos.sentinels.line3: A Keeper guards every seal and now and then makes a small version of one of its tower's moves. Elites glow, take half as much again to bring down, and always drop forge material.
handbook.realms_of_chaos.sentinels.line4: Each tower has twenty-one kinds, and most have one trick of their own. They cover for each other: a shield-bearer turns blows from its front and shelters those beside it, a warden takes half of what lands on its allies, a standard-bearer strengthens them, a dancer trades places with a wounded one, a singer stands a fallen one back up.
handbook.realms_of_chaos.sentinels.line5: Others are there to make trouble: bombers that run at you and burst, binders that root or drag you, sowers whose bolts leave ground that hurts, snipers that aim along a line of light, thieves that knock your weapon into your pack, silencers that stop your relic's move, mirages that split into three, and heralds that wake the rooms next door. Kill the helper first.
handbook.realms_of_chaos.relics.title: Relics and their moves
handbook.realms_of_chaos.relics.line1: Every god drops its relic the first time you beat it. Each relic has a kind - blade, dagger, polearm, heavy, scythe, staff, bow, thrown or relic - and a power on every hit.
handbook.realms_of_chaos.relics.line2: A relic casts its god's signature move. Right-click with a melee relic; sneak and right-click with a ranged one. It recharges in twelve seconds.
handbook.realms_of_chaos.relics.line3: Every fourth hit in a row is a flourish for half as much damage again. Relics gain experience from kills and level up to 10.
handbook.realms_of_chaos.forge.title: The Forge of Chaos
handbook.realms_of_chaos.forge.line1: Hold a relic and right-click a Forge of Chaos. Stars cost forge materials from the relic's own tower, and each needs the relic to be a high enough level.
handbook.realms_of_chaos.forge.line2: Forging is struck, not clicked: three strikes, timed on the bar. No misses and two perfect strikes is a masterwork, which tempers the star for extra damage.
handbook.realms_of_chaos.forge.line3: Three stars empower the relic's move. Five make it echo. You can pour your own experience levels into a relic with Infuse.
handbook.realms_of_chaos.party.title: Playing together
handbook.realms_of_chaos.party.line1: Form a party of up to four from the Codex. A party enters a tower on the floor of its highest member.
handbook.realms_of_chaos.party.line2: Your progress is your own: you go up past a floor only when you have beaten its god yourself - with help or without - and walked its passage.
handbook.realms_of_chaos.party.line3: Everyone who fights gets their own loot. Trials are harder with more of you.
handbook.realms_of_chaos.cards.title: Tarot and dolls
handbook.realms_of_chaos.cards.line1: The gods of the tower of Hades drop tarot cards. Right-click to play one; each does something different. Hades himself drops the Deck of Fate, which never runs out.
handbook.realms_of_chaos.cards.line2: Voodoo dolls are stitched from wheat and string round a pin. Bind one to a creature and stabbing the doll hurts the creature from afar.
handbook.realms_of_chaos.commands.title: Commands
handbook.realms_of_chaos.commands.line1: /roc - this menu.  /roc hub - back to the hub from inside the realms.  /roc leave - go home.  /roc forge - the forge screen.  /roc scan - begin a compass scan.  /roc sidebar - the side panel on or off.  /roc skills - the mastery tree.  /roc chart - a new Passage Chart.
handbook.realms_of_chaos.commands.line2: /roc party invite <player>, /roc party accept, /roc party leave.

story.realms_of_chaos.prologue.title: The Oracle's Letter
story.realms_of_chaos.prologue.blurb: A letter that found you. It asks for help.
story.realms_of_chaos.prologue.page1:
If you are reading this, the last of my ravens found you.

I am the Oracle. Once of Delphi. Now of nowhere you could walk to.
story.realms_of_chaos.prologue.page2: Chaos has woken: the first thing that ever was, older than any god. It does not hate the world. It is simply taking it back, one story at a time.
story.realms_of_chaos.prologue.page3:
The gods of the sky, the sea and the dead have shut themselves in three towers to hold it off.

They are losing.
story.realms_of_chaos.prologue.page4:
The gates to their realm were broken on purpose, so no mortal would wander in.

I am asking you to wander in.
story.realms_of_chaos.prologue.page5:
Take the compass. It remembers where a gate still stands.

The gate will want three keystones. You will find seekers there that know the way to each.

Hurry.
story.realms_of_chaos.sundering.title: The Sundering
story.realms_of_chaos.sundering.blurb: How the gods hid, and what it cost them.
story.realms_of_chaos.sundering.page1:
When Chaos rose, Zeus did the one thing a king hates.

He hid.
story.realms_of_chaos.sundering.page2:
The three brothers raised towers in a realm between realms and locked every god of their houses inside: the least at the foot, themselves at the crown.

A wall of gods between Chaos and the world.
story.realms_of_chaos.sundering.page3: Then they broke the gates and gave the keystones away: one to the sky, one to the tides, one to the dark. Each to keep what it was owed.
story.realms_of_chaos.sundering.page4:
But a wall that stands in Chaos does not stay a wall.

The gods you will meet no longer know what they are guarding. They only know they must not be passed.
story.realms_of_chaos.sundering.page5:
Set the three keystones in the arch above the pedestal. The gate will wake.

What is on the other side has been waiting a long time for someone stubborn.
story.realms_of_chaos.sky.title: Keystone of the Sky
story.realms_of_chaos.sky.blurb: Where Zeus set his keystone, and what waits in his tower.
story.realms_of_chaos.sky.page1:
Zeus set his keystone where eagles could watch it.

You are holding it now, which says something about the eagles.
story.realms_of_chaos.sky.page2: His tower is the brightest and the proudest. Messengers at its foot. Fear and dread on the stair. War and wisdom near the crown.
story.realms_of_chaos.sky.page3:
They will greet you as a thief. Do not argue.

A god beaten in fair trial remembers itself, for a while. That is the whole of the plan.
story.realms_of_chaos.sea.title: Keystone of the Tides
story.realms_of_chaos.sea.blurb: Where Poseidon left his keystone, and what waits in his tower.
story.realms_of_chaos.sea.page1: Poseidon gave his keystone to the water, and the water kept it the way water keeps everything: carelessly, and for ever.
story.realms_of_chaos.sea.page2: His tower goes down, whatever your feet tell you. Sunlit shallows, then drowned halls, then the trench, where no light was ever asked for.
story.realms_of_chaos.sea.page3:
The sea does not hate you.

It simply does not stop. Learn its rhythm and strike between the waves.
story.realms_of_chaos.shade.title: Keystone of the Shades
story.realms_of_chaos.shade.blurb: Where Hades buried his keystone, and what waits in his tower.
story.realms_of_chaos.shade.page1: Hades buried his keystone, as he buries everything, and marked the place so that it could be found by anyone willing to go down.
story.realms_of_chaos.shade.page2: His tower is the quietest. The ferryman at its door will take your measure. The dreams above him will lie to you kindly.
story.realms_of_chaos.shade.page3:
At the top sits a king who never wanted a throne, holding the one deck of cards that Chaos is afraid of.

Ask him for it. Loudly.
story.realms_of_chaos.hub.title: The Hub of Realms
story.realms_of_chaos.hub.blurb: The Oracle speaks: where you are, and what the trials are for.
story.realms_of_chaos.hub.page1:
You stand where three realms touch.

North, Olympus. East, the Abyss. West, the Underworld. South, the way home, which I advise you to remember.
story.realms_of_chaos.hub.page2:
The flame you are speaking to is me. I burn here so the towers have something to point at.

The figures by the gates are echoes. They still turn their heads. Be polite.
story.realms_of_chaos.hub.page3:
Understand what a trial is. You do not slay a god. You wake one.

Each relic is the thanks of a god who has remembered its own name.
story.realms_of_chaos.hub.page4:
Between the floors lie passages: what Chaos made of the stairs. Break its seals and the way opens.

Climb. I will write down what you find.
story.realms_of_chaos.zeus_foot.title: Olympus: The Foothills
story.realms_of_chaos.zeus_foot.blurb: The first gods of the sky tower.
story.realms_of_chaos.zeus_foot.page1: Iris ran messages between gods who stopped listening. She still runs. Nobody told her the letters are blank.
story.realms_of_chaos.zeus_foot.page2: The foothills are green because Chaos has not finished with them. Enjoy the moss. Higher up it is marble, and marble does not forgive.
story.realms_of_chaos.zeus_mid.title: Olympus: The Marble Halls
story.realms_of_chaos.zeus_mid.blurb: Five gods of the sky are awake.
story.realms_of_chaos.zeus_mid.page1: Five awake. Hebe poured you a cup, I hope. She has been pouring for nobody for a very long time.
story.realms_of_chaos.zeus_mid.page2: Fear and Dread guard the same stair as Medicine. That was never the order of things. Chaos shuffles gods the way a bored hand shuffles cards.
story.realms_of_chaos.zeus_mid.page3: Ares is above you. He was not locked in. He volunteered. Keep that in mind when he smiles.
story.realms_of_chaos.zeus_high.title: Olympus: The Cloud Sanctum
story.realms_of_chaos.zeus_high.blurb: Ten gods of the sky are awake.
story.realms_of_chaos.zeus_high.page1: Ten awake, and the clouds are beginning to move again. From down here it looks like weather. It is the sky remembering how.
story.realms_of_chaos.zeus_high.page2: Artemis will not miss. Apollo will not stop talking. Athena has already worked out how this ends and is checking her sums by fighting you.
story.realms_of_chaos.zeus_high.page3: Then the summit. He will not be glad to see you. He will be relieved, and hate that.
story.realms_of_chaos.zeus_fall.title: Zeus Speaks
story.realms_of_chaos.zeus_fall.blurb: The king of the gods, awake.
story.realms_of_chaos.zeus_fall.page1: "I built a wall out of my own children and called it wisdom."
story.realms_of_chaos.zeus_fall.page2:
"Every one of them you woke, I felt. Like stones coming out of a dam. I thought the flood would be Chaos.

It was only the truth, which is worse and more useful."
story.realms_of_chaos.zeus_fall.page3:
"Take the thunderbolt. I threw it at everything except the one thing that mattered.

You will aim better. You have had practice. On us."
story.realms_of_chaos.poseidon_foot.blur: The first gods of the sea tower.
story.realms_of_chaos.poseidon_foot.page:
Galatea was a statue once, then loved into life. Chaos is trying to remind her of the statue.

Remind her of the other part.
The shallows are kind. That is how the sea begins every conversation.
story.realms_of_chaos.poseidon_mid.title: The Abyss: Drowned Halls
story.realms_of_chaos.poseidon_mid.blurb: Five gods of the sea are awake.
story.realms_of_chaos.poseidon_mid.page1:
Five awake, and the tide in the hub has started keeping time.

Proteus will be whoever you least want to fight. Do not take it personally. He does it to everyone.
story.realms_of_chaos.poseidon_mid.page2: Old Nereus knows every answer and gives none of them willingly. He is the only god in that tower who is hiding on purpose.
story.realms_of_chaos.poseidon_mid.page3: Below the halls the light gives up. Bring your own.
story.realms_of_chaos.poseidon_high.blur: Ten gods of the sea are awake.
story.realms_of_chaos.poseidon_high.page: Ten awake. The canals here run clear now. You did that.
Chrysaor was born with a golden sword in his hand and has never once put it down. Triton's horn can be heard through stone. The Queen is patient. She married the sea.
And then him. Earthshaker. Mind your footing.
story.realms_of_chaos.poseidon_fall.blur: The lord of the seas, awake.
story.realms_of_chaos.poseidon_fall.page: "My brother built a wall. I built a depth. I thought nothing could follow us down there."
"Something did. It was patient, the way I am patient. I mistook it for myself. For an age I sat in the dark, proud of how still the water was."

"Take the trident. It was made to stir things.

Go and stir my brother in the west. He has been still the longest."
story.realms_of_chaos.hades_foot.title: Underworld: Fields of Asphodel
story.realms_of_chaos.hades_foot.blurb: The first gods of the tower of the dead.
story.realms_of_chaos.hades_foot.page1: Charon wants a coin. He has always wanted a coin. Pay him the other way.
story.realms_of_chaos.hades_foot.page2: The fields are grey because the dead forget colour first. The dreams that drift here are the Oneiroi. They mean no harm. They do it anyway.
story.realms_of_chaos.hades_mid.title: Underworld: Tartarus
story.realms_of_chaos.hades_mid.blurb: Five gods of the dead are awake.
story.realms_of_chaos.hades_mid.page1: Five awake. The Fates measured your thread while you fought them. I looked over their shoulders. It is longer than they expected.
story.realms_of_chaos.hades_mid.page2: The Furies punish oath-breakers. Chaos convinced them everything is a broken oath. In a way it is right, which is why they are so hard to wake.
story.realms_of_chaos.hades_mid.page3: Night herself is above you. Nyx is older than the towers, older than me. Chaos is her mother. She has not decided whose side she is on.
story.realms_of_chaos.hades_high.title: Underworld: Halls of the Dead
story.realms_of_chaos.hades_high.blurb: Ten gods of the dead are awake.
story.realms_of_chaos.hades_high.page1: Ten awake. Sleep and Death are brothers, and you have met one. The other is coming, and for once he is the one who is afraid.
story.realms_of_chaos.hades_high.page2: Zagreus fights like someone who has died often and resents each time. Persephone keeps the seasons of a place that has none.
story.realms_of_chaos.hades_high.page3: And the king. He kept the dead in order when order was unfashionable. He will make you earn every step.
story.realms_of_chaos.hades_fall.title: Hades Speaks
story.realms_of_chaos.hades_fall.blurb: The king of the dead, awake.
story.realms_of_chaos.hades_fall.page1: "They gave me the dark because nobody else wanted it. I kept it well. Chaos came, and I thought: here at last is something darker. I can rest."
story.realms_of_chaos.hades_fall.page2: "That was the lie it told me. Not that I was weak. That I was finished."
story.realms_of_chaos.hades_fall.page3:
"Take the deck. Every card in it is a story Chaos could not eat. I have been dealing them into the dark for an age, hoping somebody would pick one up.

Somebody did."
story.realms_of_chaos.epilogue.title: What Comes After
story.realms_of_chaos.epilogue.blurb: Three kings awake. The Oracle looks further.
story.realms_of_chaos.epilogue.page1:
Three kings awake. Forty-five gods who know their names.

Chaos is not beaten. It cannot be. It is what everything is made of.
story.realms_of_chaos.epilogue.page2: But it has been told no, by a mortal, forty-five times. It is not used to that. It has drawn back from these towers like a tide.
story.realms_of_chaos.epilogue.page3:
It has not gone far. I can feel other gates, in other places it is busy unmaking.

A bridge of light that is not Iris's. A river lined with reeds.
story.realms_of_chaos.epilogue.page4:
And a mountain where a blade is folded a thousand times before anyone dares to call it finished.

Rest. Sharpen what they gave you. Then come back to the flame.
